d: Established in 1985, Gulf Rock is a specialist rock engineering company supporting infrastructure, mining and development projects across the Gulf region.

Operating across the UAE, Oman and Saudi Arabia, we combine proven Swedish engineering methodology with decades of regional experience to help clients work safely and effectively in challenging ground conditions.

Our expertise spans rock engineering, underground construction, surface earthworks, utility and drainage infrastructure, rock slope engineering, controlled rock works, rock placement, mining support services, processing and recycling, rock supply and specialist project delivery.

At Gulf Rock, we believe successful projects begin long before physical work starts. By doing the groundwork before we break ground, we help clients reduce uncertainty, manage risk and prepare for successful delivery through careful planning, technical judgement and disciplined execution.
Our work is guided by the ROCKERS values: Respectful, Organised, Collaborative, Knowledgeable, Ethical, Resourceful and Safe.
Doing the Groundwork Before We Break Ground.

As an Admin. Project Storekeeper (Explosive) - Senior is responsible for the safe, secure, compliant and efficient control of explosive materials and associated accessories within the licensed storage facilities. The position represents a clear progression from administrative support duties to senior operational accountability, including custody of stock, reconciliation, compliance assurance, team guidance, reporting and coordination with management, authorised users, suppliers, transporters and regulatory representatives.
Assume day-to-day senior control of the explosive magazine and associated records during the assigned shift or period of responsibility.
Act as the primary point of coordination for explosive receipts, issues, returns, transfers and stock verification, subject to company authorisations and regulatory requirements.
Provide guidance, task allocation and on-the-job coaching to storekeeping and authorised support personnel.
Identify discrepancies, unsafe conditions or non-compliance promptly, stop the affected activity where necessary, preserve evidence and escalate through the approved management and HSE channels.
Demonstrate readiness to support audits, inspections.
Manage the daily operation, security, housekeeping and access control of the explosive storage facility in accordance with approved procedures and licence conditions.
Verify all receipts, issues, returns and transfers against approved documentation, authorised personnel, quantity, type, batch and condition before completing the transaction.
Maintain accurate electronic and manual inventory records, including daily balances, transaction registers, delivery documentation, issue/return records and discrepancy logs.
Complete daily stock checks and scheduled cycle counts; lead month-end physical reconciliation and investigate variances immediately.
Ensure explosives and detonators are segregated, stored, stacked and handled correctly, with stock rotation and shelf-life controls applied.
Coordinate deliveries and collections with suppliers, approved transporters, security, operations and management, ensuring permits and documentation are available before movement.
Inspect magazines, locks, fencing, lighting, fire protection, signage, earthing, environmental conditions and other critical controls; record defects and track corrective action.
Ensure damaged, deteriorated, expired, suspect or quarantined materials are isolated, clearly identified and reported for authorised disposition.
Brief, coach and supervise storekeeping or authorised support staff on safe handling, documentation, emergency arrangements and site-specific controls.
Prepare accurate daily, weekly and monthly stock, movement, compliance and exception reports for the Underground Mine Manager.
